expires_today.title: Robotics and Electronics from Beginner to Expert by Apress
expires_today.long_description: If you’re a robot enthusiast or just looking to get into a new tech hobby, this bundle of robotics and electronics books from Apress will have you building supercomputers and monster-fighting mech suits in no time! If you’ve ever wanted to dive into robotics, this is the bundle for you. Get over $1,000-worth of tech books for the price of your choice, and support Room to Read charity with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Humanoids Megabundle: Universes Unbound, Part 1 by Humanoids
expires_tomorrow.description: Comics like you’ve never seen them before
expires_tomorrow.long_description: A detective on the hunt for an ancient artifact. A universe ruled by futuristic technology. A climate crisis driven by swarms of insects. This is just a taste of what’s in store for you in this bundle of comics from Humanoids, full of old classics and new favorites! Rediscover classics from the master Alejandro Jodorowsky, from The Incal to The Technopriests to Son of the Gun and more! Try out new bestsellers like the mosquito-fueled climate change parable Dengue and the post-apocalyptic vampire survival tale The Last Ones! Immerse yourself in the imaginative stories and unique artwork collected in Humanoids’ 2000s relaunch of the iconic anthology Métal Hurlant! Those are just a few of what’s in this bundle of more than 30 great comic series from one of the best publishers operating today, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Reading Is Fundamental with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.description: Worlds of adventure in the palm of your hand

expires_within_72h.title: Liminal Spaces
expires_within_72h.long_description:
There are few things scarier than being trapped in a place that shouldn’t exist—and that’s exactly why we love playing liminal horror games! With the Backrooms movie taking over movie theaters this summer, now’s the time to see how well you’d survive in these hostile environments full of monsters and other oddities. Inspired by the Backrooms urban legend, in The Cabin Factory your job is to explore a series of cabins looking for hauntings—and get out fast if you find any! For a more traditional approach, The Backrooms: Survival turns liminal horror into a roguelike survival game you can play solo or with friends! Enter these cursed, otherworldly places if you dare at the price of your choice, and support Spaceship Earth UK with your purchase!
